description.zh-CN: 清楚地表达操作，给等待一个确定的反馈。
description.en: Clear actions and definite feedback while waiting.

description.zh-CN: 从填写到校验，保持简单而清晰。
description.en: Simple, clear input and validation.

description.zh-CN: 独立字段标签，沿用原生 htmlFor 与 ref。
description.en: A standalone field label with native htmlFor and ref support.

description.zh-CN: 多行文本输入，保留原生表单、引用与草稿语义。
description.en: Multiline input with native form, ref, and draft semantics.

description.zh-CN: 原生选择器、选项与分组，保留移动端系统选择器。
description.en: Native select, options, and groups with the mobile system picker.

description.zh-CN: 有限选项单选，支持受控值与键盘选择。
description.en: Finite single selection with controlled values and keyboard selection.

description.zh-CN: 可输入筛选的选值控件，保留空结果和键盘导航。
description.en: Searchable selection with empty results and keyboard navigation.

description.zh-CN: 原生表单关联的三态复选框，选择与焦点分离。
description.en: Form-associated three-state checkbox with distinct selection and focus.

description.zh-CN: 常规单选组，键盘选择、焦点与表单值由 Base UI 管理。
description.en: A standard radio group with Base UI keyboard navigation, focus, and form values.

description.zh-CN: 受控或非受控开关，保留原生表单与只读状态。
description.en: A controlled or uncontrolled switch with form and read-only support.

description.zh-CN: 让用户专注于眼前的一件事。
description.en: Help users focus on one task.

description.zh-CN: 左右及底部抽屉，固定首尾、正文滚动与嵌套焦点管理。
description.en: Left, right and bottom sheets with fixed header/footer, scrolling body and nested focus management.

description.zh-CN: 带主题继承的辅助信息浮层，不伪造业务反馈。
description.en: Themed supplementary popover with caller-owned business feedback.

description.zh-CN: 动作菜单，沿用方向键、禁用与 Escape 焦点恢复。
description.en: Action menu with arrow keys, disabled items and Escape focus recovery.

description.zh-CN: 复用Menu的动作、复选及单选菜单，支持键盘定位。
description.en: Actions, checkbox and radio menus built on Menu with keyboard navigation.

description.zh-CN: 内容面板切换，选中与焦点分开并支持方向键。
description.en: Content tabs with separate selection and focus plus arrow keys.

description.zh-CN: 分段量值显示，使用meter语义并明确未知值。
description.en: Segmented quantity display with meter semantics and explicit unknown values.

description.zh-CN: 带文本替代的微型柱状趋势，覆盖空值、缺失和等值。
description.en: Miniature bar trends with text alternatives for empty, missing and equal values.

description.zh-CN: 语义化快捷键呈现，不注册键盘事件。
description.en: Semantic shortcut display without keyboard registration.

description.zh-CN: 统一标签、描述与错误关联，保留调用方输入草稿。
description.en: Consistent labels, descriptions and errors while preserving caller drafts.

description.zh-CN: 受控或非受控数值滑块，连续变化与提交回调分离。
description.en: Controlled or uncontrolled numeric slider with separate change and commit callbacks.

description.zh-CN: 互斥选值分段控件，使用 radio 语义与方向键。
description.en: Exclusive segmented selection with radio semantics and arrow keys.

description.zh-CN: 兼容宿主或隔离主题的作用域，Portal 继承对应实例的变量。
description.en: A boundary for host-compatible or isolated themes; portals inherit their instance variables.

description.zh-CN: 提供简体中文与英文、类型化消息、Intl 格式化和结构化界面反馈。
description.en: Simplified Chinese and English, typed messages, Intl formatting and structured UI feedback.

description.zh-CN: 只读的信息徽标，支持语义色、小圆角和胶囊外观。
description.en: Read-only information badge with semantic tones, small corners and pill shapes.

description.zh-CN: 胶囊外观的只读分类标签，区分分类与交互值。
description.en: Read-only pill category labels, distinct from interactive values.

description.zh-CN: 可选择、移除的受控胶囊，主操作与删除是兄弟目标。
description.en: Controlled selectable, removable pills with sibling main and removal targets.

description.zh-CN: 统一列表行。交互、选中和运行状态分开表达，尾部操作独立。
description.en: A shared list row with separate interaction, selection and runtime states, and independent trailing actions.

description.zh-CN: 统一数据区域：首次骨架、空状态、部分数据与保留旧内容的错误反馈。
description.en: Shared data region: initial skeletons, empty and partial states, and errors that preserve existing content.

description.zh-CN: 受控通用表格，勾选、查看与排序请求分别建模。
description.en: Controlled generic table separating selection, activation and sorting requests.

description.zh-CN: 原生表格结构，保留表头、单元格、标题和滚动语义。
description.en: Native table structure preserving headers, cells, caption and scrolling semantics.

description.zh-CN: 完整树键盘模型、Idea → Session → Run 层级与受控节点移动。
description.en: Complete tree keyboard model, Idea → Session → Run hierarchy and controlled node movement.

description.zh-CN: 工作项搜索、筛选、布局、排序与显示设置。
description.en: Work item search, filters, layout, sorting and display options.

description.zh-CN: 工作项共享属性与选择器，业务状态独立于运行状态。
description.en: Shared work item properties and pickers, with business state separate from runtime.

description.zh-CN: 工作项行与卡片，主目标、勾选及属性为兄弟目标。
description.en: Work item rows and cards with sibling activation, selection and property targets.

description.zh-CN: 工作项行与卡片，主目标、勾选及属性为兄弟目标。
description.en: Work item rows and cards with sibling activation, selection and property targets.

description.zh-CN: 头像图片、姓名缩写与读取失败回退。
description.en: Avatar images, initials and image-error fallback.

description.zh-CN: 组合筛选、排序与计数，窄屏使用Sheet容纳筛选。
description.en: Filter, sort and count slots with a Sheet for narrow-screen filters.

description.zh-CN: 使用名称、值、单位和说明展示调用方计算的指标。
description.en: Displays caller-computed metrics with labels, values, units and descriptions.

description.zh-CN: 只读评分与半星显示，提供完整文本替代。
description.en: Read-only ratings and half stars with complete text alternatives.

description.zh-CN: 受控分组列表，保留分组读取状态与未知总数。
description.en: Controlled grouped list with per-group read states and unknown totals.

description.zh-CN: 同一工作项快照的列表、看板和表格适配。
description.en: List, board and table adapters for the same work item snapshot.

description.zh-CN: 同一工作项快照的列表、看板和表格适配。
description.en: List, board and table adapters for the same work item snapshot.

description.zh-CN: 同一工作项快照的列表、看板和表格适配。
description.en: List, board and table adapters for the same work item snapshot.

description.zh-CN: 受控工作项详情及保留失败草稿的快速创建。
description.en: Controlled work item detail and quick creation retaining rejected drafts.

description.zh-CN: 通用受控看板，指针、触屏与键盘移动共享命令。
description.en: Business-independent controlled board sharing pointer, touch and keyboard move commands.

description.zh-CN: 受控批量字段修改、逐项回执与调用方保存视图接口。
description.en: Controlled batch field changes, per-item receipts and caller-owned saved view interfaces.

description.zh-CN: 受控批量字段修改、逐项回执与调用方保存视图接口。
description.en: Controlled batch field changes, per-item receipts and caller-owned saved view interfaces.

description.zh-CN: 业务无关的排期行、按日吸附与区间裁切。
description.en: Business-independent scheduling rows, day snapping and clipped ranges.

description.zh-CN: 受控月、周与当日Agenda，消费权威按日快照。
description.en: Controlled month, week and daily agenda with authoritative date buckets.

description.zh-CN: 受控排期锚点、刻度、每周首日与周末显隐。
description.en: Controlled schedule anchors, scales, week starts and weekend visibility.

description.zh-CN: 成对日期意图、字段权限、校验与失败草稿保留。
description.en: Atomic date intentions with field permissions, validation and retained drafts.

description.zh-CN: 去重未排期队列与紧凑工作项日历条目。
description.en: Deduplicated unscheduled queue and compact work item calendar entries.

description.zh-CN: 工作项排期，平移与两端调整使用独立字段能力。
description.en: Work item scheduling with independent shift and endpoint resize capabilities.

description.zh-CN: 仅修改截止日的日历、逐日分页与未排期工作项。
description.en: Due-date-only calendar changes, daily paging and unscheduled work items.

description.zh-CN: Session、Agent、Activity与Tool Call共用的十种运行状态语言。
description.en: The ten runtime states shared by Session, Agent, Activity and Tool Call.

description.zh-CN: Agent 身份、模型、连接状态、汇总负载和统一运行状态。
description.en: Agent identity, model, connectivity, aggregate load and shared runtime status.

description.zh-CN: Session 双行结构，选择与运行状态独立，操作由显式能力开放。
description.en: Two-line Session rows with independent selection/runtime states and explicit action capabilities.

description.zh-CN: 同轴消息、独立工具槽、可中断输出、对话/工作区分栏与 IME 安全输入。
description.en: Same-axis messages, independent tool slots, interruptible output, conversation/workspace panes and IME-safe input.

description.zh-CN: 独立工具执行记录：参数/输出、截断、脱敏、权限请求和未确认结果。
description.en: Independent tool execution records with arguments/output, truncation, redaction, permission requests and unconfirmed results.

description.zh-CN: Runtime 时间线：平铺事件、详情展开、去重、滚动跟随及新事件提示。
description.en: Runtime timeline with flat events, expandable details, deduplication, scroll following and new-event indicators.

description.zh-CN: 共享运行身份、模型、耗时与原始状态。
description.en: Shared run identity, model, duration and source runtime status.

description.zh-CN: 紧凑运行行；查看与尾部操作使用兄弟目标。
description.en: Compact run row with sibling activation and trailing targets.

description.zh-CN: 独立运行卡片；缺失计数保留为未知。
description.en: Independent run card retaining unknown counts.

description.zh-CN: 同一运行集合的只读分组列表。
description.en: Read-only grouped list over shared run snapshots.

description.zh-CN: 按来源状态派生分列的只读运行看板。
description.en: Read-only run board grouped by source status.

description.zh-CN: 完整受控运行详情，组合请求、执行、产物与关联。
description.en: Complete controlled run detail composing requests, traces, artifacts and relationships.

description.zh-CN: 仅展示来源明确的运行关联与交接。
description.en: Only explicit source relationships and handoffs.

description.zh-CN: 来源用量去重、覆盖说明与分币种合计。
description.en: Deduplicated source usage, coverage and per-currency totals.

description.zh-CN: 共享运行筛选与可选依赖视图受控切换。
description.en: Shared run filters and an optional controlled dependency view.

description.zh-CN: 受控 Agent 工作台；路由、服务与持久化归调用方。
description.en: Controlled Agent workspace; routing, services and persistence belong to callers.

description.zh-CN: 仅展示来源明确的运行依赖；只读画布与可访问列表同步。
description.en: Source-reported run dependencies in a read-only canvas and accessible list.

description.zh-CN: 来源区间历史；运行与币种独立，缺失观测保留断点。
description.en: Source interval history; separate runs and currencies with gaps for missing observations.

description.zh-CN: 可变行高的受控运行列表，保留离屏焦点和完整加载口径。
description.en: Controlled variable-height run list with off-screen focus and explicit loaded scope.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 可编辑流程工作台：构图、配置、变量、校验、撤销和导入导出。
description.en: An editable workflow workspace for graph editing, configuration, variables, validation, undo and import/export.

description.zh-CN: 按分类和名称查找节点，支持点击新增与拖放目录。
description.en: Find nodes by category and name; add by clicking or dragging from the palette.

description.zh-CN: 复用 Inspector 的受控节点配置，保留无效草稿并校验后应用。
description.en: Controlled node configuration reuses Inspector, preserves invalid drafts and validates before applying.

description.zh-CN: 复用单选 Tree，选择可达上游的兼容输出并生成结构化引用。
description.en: Reuses single-selection Tree to choose compatible, reachable upstream outputs and create structured references.

description.zh-CN: 受控服务面板：版本恢复、讨论、临时 Presence、环境、分享和发布回执。
description.en: Controlled service panel for version restoration, discussions, transient presence, environments, sharing and publication receipts.

description.zh-CN: 显式边界与递归校验的嵌套流程工作台，保留每个子图的选择、视口和本地历史。
description.en: A nested workflow workspace with explicit boundaries and recursion validation, preserving each graph's selection, viewport and local history.

description.zh-CN: 条件、对象 Schema、键值表、表达式和代码的受控编辑器。
description.en: Controlled editors for conditions, object schemas, key-value tables, expressions and code.

description.zh-CN: 受控执行调试：运行、停止请求、审批、脱敏输出和未知结果对账。
description.en: Controlled execution debugging: run, stop requests, approval, redacted output and unknown-outcome reconciliation.

description.zh-CN: 流程图的视觉分组；移动由命令整体更新成员位置。
description.en: A visual workflow group; commands move all member positions together.

description.zh-CN: 流程说明便笺，独立于执行与讨论线程。
description.en: Workflow notes, independent of execution and discussion threads.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 组合三种工作项布局与详情，路由和服务由调用方持有。
description.en: Three work item layouts and detail composition; caller owns routing and services.

description.zh-CN: 紧凑Agent工作台骨架：Sidebar、Main、可调整的Inspector与可选底部面板。
description.en: A compact Agent workspace shell with Sidebar, Main, resizable Inspector and optional bottom panel.

description.zh-CN: 当前对象的受控详情，统一 Metadata、缺失字段与复制反馈。
description.en: Controlled object details with shared Metadata, missing-field and copy feedback.

description.zh-CN: A/B 样式实验：实时修改圆角、间距、阴影、颜色和字体，比较参数并复制 CSS。
description.en: A/B foundation experiments: adjust radius, spacing, shadows, colors and typography; compare parameters and copy CSS.

description.zh-CN: 调用方提供结果的命令搜索，支持键盘选择与IME。
description.en: Command search with caller-owned results, keyboard selection and IME support.

description.zh-CN: 使用fieldset和legend组织表单分组。
description.en: Form sections using fieldset and legend.

description.zh-CN: 本地图片选择、拖放、预览、替换与失败恢复。
description.en: Local image selection, drop, preview, replacement and failure recovery.

description.zh-CN: 把任务的等待、执行、完成和失败，一眼说清。
description.en: Task waiting, execution, completion and failure at a glance.

description.zh-CN: 六种滚动交互，亲手体验：触发、联动、视差、吸顶、吸附与横向展开。
description.en: Try six scroll interactions: triggered, linked, parallax, sticky, snap and horizontal.

description.zh-CN: 来源阶段与有明确分母的步骤计数，不生成假进度。
description.en: Source stages and bounded step counts without synthetic progress.

description.zh-CN: 按关注 ID 去重；请求数与运行数分别表达。
description.en: Attention ID deduplication with separate request and run counts.

description.zh-CN: 工具审批复用 ToolCall；未知结果必须先核对。
description.en: Tool approval composes ToolCall; unknown results require reconciliation.

description.zh-CN: 产物入口、可用状态与独立审阅摘要。
description.en: Artifact links, availability and independent review summaries.

description.zh-CN: 审阅、业务验收与 PR 状态分别呈现。
description.en: Separate review, business acceptance and PR states.

description.zh-CN: 可观测父子执行步骤与脱敏工具详情。
description.en: Observable parent-child steps and redacted tool detail.

description.zh-CN: 通用受控看板，指针、触屏与键盘移动共享命令。
description.en: Business-independent controlled board sharing pointer, touch and keyboard move commands.
